data.narrative:
Vannevar Labs is a Series B-stage defense and security company founded by Brett Granberg and Nini Moorhead that has raised $90M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable set of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms operating in the same sector and stage, including Dream Security, Harmattan AI, Code Metal, Castelion, and Defense Unicorns.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $90M in total capital raised as a proxy baseline and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $171M. Peer-median analysis examined 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $300M to $3.0B; the median across this set is $1.0B. The wide range reflects material heterogeneity within defense-tech valuations at this stage.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $145M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $586M. The substantial spread—roughly 8x between low and high—reflects genuine uncertainty about where Vannevar sits within its peer cohort. Key variables include relative progress on customer traction, technology differentiation versus peers like Dream Security and Harmattan AI, and capital efficiency relative to the $90M invested. Additional diligence on revenue run-rate and customer concentration would narrow the range materially.
